summary: feat(core): pluggable settings reference expansion and declarative secret stores — resource.Scheme/ReferenceResolver open ${scheme:ref} expansion (env/base/home built in, \${...} escaping), the deploy builder centralizes expansion across resources/engines/hooks, secret.Store resources (env/file impls) feed a lazy ${secret:NAME}/${secret:store.NAME} scheme, and resource.Secret carries literals or refs resolved at request time through Input.Secrets with per-store TTL caching and <secret> redaction; driver profile secrets migrate to typed values so missing keys fail at request time
